idea_title: Smart Home Good Night Scene Control
summary: Tapping an NFC sticker on a nightstand triggers a smart home good night scene that automatically turns off all home lights.
how_it_works: An NFC sticker is scanned with an iPhone and named 'nightstand'. In iOS Shortcuts automations, setting the trigger to this NFC tag executes the HomeKit 'Good Night' scene to turn off all connected lights.
source_title: 15 NEW Shortcuts YOU Requested - Alarms, NFC Tags, Photos & More!
anchor_quote: run my smart home good night scene to turn off all the lights

summary: Scanning an NFC sticker attached to household items like paper towels automatically adds that specific item to a designated Apple Reminders list.
how_it_works: An NFC sticker is assigned an iOS Shortcuts automation that runs immediately upon scan. The automation executes the 'Add New Reminder' action with the item title set to 'paper towels' in a selected list.
source_title: 15 NEW Shortcuts YOU Requested - Alarms, NFC Tags, Photos & More!
anchor_quote: running the automation which adds it to my reminders

summary: Tapping an NFC tag initiates music playback from an Apple Music library and routes audio to an AirPlay 2 speaker, HomePod, or Sonos system.
how_it_works: Scanning the tag triggers an iOS Shortcuts automation running the 'Play Music' action for a chosen playlist or album, followed by a playback destination action specifying an AirPlay 2 or HomePod target.
source_title: 15 NEW Shortcuts YOU Requested - Alarms, NFC Tags, Photos & More!
anchor_quote: when you scan an NFC tag you can have it start playing music

summary: An embedded hardware system reads NFC card unique IDs and matches them against stored personnel records to automatically log attendance.
how_it_works: An NFC module (e.g. PN532) connected to an Arduino or Raspberry Pi reads a card UID when tapped. Serial data is transmitted to a Python script running on a host computer to identify the individual and record attendance.
source_title: Near Field Communication (NFC) for Embedded Applications -- Agus Kurniawan -- 1, 2015 -- PE Press -- 46dc154007622252b3ef25a3d1f659bc -- Anna’s Archive.epub
anchor_quote: Register NFC cards to specific person When NFC card is swapped, a program will send data to computer
notes: Embedded hardware system utilizing Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and Python.

summary: A hardware-based point-of-sale setup deducts purchase amounts from pre-registered cardholder accounts upon scanning an NFC card.
how_it_works: An NFC card is tapped on a PN532 module connected to a Raspberry Pi. The software reads the card UID, looks up the cardholder's pre-loaded deposit balance, deducts the item price, and updates the stored value.
source_title: Near Field Communication (NFC) for Embedded Applications -- Agus Kurniawan -- 1, 2015 -- PE Press -- 46dc154007622252b3ef25a3d1f659bc -- Anna’s Archive.epub
anchor_quote: Each NFC card is registered and pointed to a person with deposit amount
notes: Embedded hardware system using C, Raspberry Pi, and PN532 module.
